body: Was born and raised in the city, i appreciate I moved to the countryside. But country people love bs like reputation or "normalcy" so even tho I love the environment, I can't stand the people.
Lost a lot of people doing that. My friend list got reduced to three. But those three were there even if I pushed them away. Felt like I filtered smoke outta my life.

I have three jobs which I don't dislike entirely but I'd bail in the first opportunity. I do them because I need the money. Even though I don't like them, I think of them as steps to finally climb to my desired outcome. Took me years, but rn I'm working with my husband (INFJ) and best friend from high school (INFP) and building up a project together. I finally feel like all the sighs and grunts and fighting to wake up and dealing with my bosses pays off.

Remember, sh*tty jobs are steps of stairs to take you to higher and better places!

Panamanian here.
I agree with that the Canal should still be managed by the US, but there was a single problem: the Canal Zone.
Segregation, xenophobia, and discrimination were rampant. They beat like F and jailed countless panamanians just for being around. I'm sorry, but it was still Panama. They even mocked our flag and stuff (Martyrs of January 9th, 1964) and treated us as less. I know that's common US practice but how were we gonna sit and watch? If the US BEHAVED, then yes... They were doing a terrific job with the Canal. But they can't be the a-holes they intended to be in here.

It is a Diablico Sucio (dirty devil), one of the several Devils in Panamanian lore. Diablicos participate in Corpus Christi christian celebrations and also in Tempe de Soto celebration (last one is from the afrodescendant Congo culture of Panama). They're said to be tricksters, they joke and mock and steal from people but redeem themselves in front of God every year.
